name: election-night
description: Android packaging for Election Night. The game itself is plain JS in frontend/ and needs no build step -- Capacitor copies that folder into the APK as-is.

scripts.android:init: npm run icons && npx cap add android && npm run android:patch && npm run android:assets && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:sync: npx cap sync android && npm run android:patch
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && echo "\nAPK: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && echo "\nAPK: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk"
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && echo "\nAAB: android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab"
